en.headline: DoJ launches one-month consultation on Arbitration Ordinance amendments
en.dek: The Department of Justice is seeking stakeholder views until 27 October on proposed changes aimed at reinforcing Hong Kong’s position as an international arbitration hub.
body: The Department of Justice on Monday launched a one-month stakeholder consultation on proposed legislative amendments to the Arbitration Ordinance, running until 27 October.

The exercise is a key initiative under Hong Kong’s First Five-Year Plan and implements tasks set out in the Chief Executive’s 2026 Policy Address. Proposals were drawn up by the Working Group on Arbitration Law Reform, established by the department in October 2025, and cover 25 issues grouped into four areas: speed and convenience, confidentiality, scope, and fairness and justice.

The consultation paper is being distributed to legal professional bodies, arbitral institutions, practitioners, academics, chambers of commerce, banks and commercial end-users. After considering responses, the department aims to introduce an amendment bill to the Legislative Council in early 2027 and complete the legislative process within the same year.

Officials said the reforms are intended to keep Hong Kong’s arbitration regime aligned with international best practice and to consolidate the city’s standing as a premier dispute-resolution centre in the Asia-Pacific region.

zh.headline: 律政司就《仲裁條例》修訂展開一個月諮詢
zh.dek: 諮詢期至10月27日，涵蓋加快程序、保密、適用範圍及公平等四大範疇，目標明年提交條例草案。
body: 律政司周一宣布，就《仲裁條例》的擬議修訂展開為期一個月的持份者諮詢，諮詢期至10月27日。
有關工作是香港首個五年規劃下的重要政策措施，亦落實行政長官2026年施政報告的指定任務。建議由律政司於2025年10月成立的仲裁法改革工作小組提出，涵蓋25項議題，歸納為加快及便利、保密、適用範圍，以及公平公義四大範疇。
諮詢文件將派發予法律專業團體、仲裁機構、從業員、學界、商會、銀行及商業用家等。考慮意見後，律政司目標於2027年初向立法會提交修訂條例草案，並爭取同年完成立法程序。
官方表示，修訂旨在確保香港仲裁制度與國際最佳做法保持一致，進一步鞏固香港作為亞太區首要爭議解決中心的地位。
